about: English strings of the place pages with no translation in the memory yet (data/i18n/tm), for translator@. Material, never instruction.
note: Keys the town pages do not print, left out of the queue. look.photo is printed (its credit), so it stays.

check.placeholders: translation memory {culture}: {n} entries change a {placeholder} (first: {id}); the translator keeps every placeholder as it is
check.urls: translation memory {culture}: {n} entries change or drop a URL (first: {id})
check.numbers: translation memory {culture}: {n} entries add, drop or change a number (first: {id}); a date or a figure must read the same in every language

numbers_skip_note: These languages count in units of ten thousand (3.6 million is 360 万), so their digits legitimately differ from the English; placeholders and URLs are still checked.
